title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1970-09-20
source: Source Info: Master Soundboard Reels (borrowed by Peter Kafer) > Will Boswell's reel @ 7 1/2 ips; Transfer Info: Reel (Technics RS1506) > Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1bit/5.6 MHz) > dBpoweramp 24/96 > Adobe Audition 3.0 > TLH flac2496

ai_review.summary: Excellent‑sounding recording of an epic show with a praised acoustic first set and a standout "Not Fade Away" in the second set.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the performance, calling it an epic show that sounds excellent. The acoustic first set is highlighted as a treat and the second set’s “Not Fade Away” receives special praise. No technical flaws are mentioned, suggesting a high‑quality source.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviews are enthusiastic (5 stars) and focus on strong musical performance with no recording complaints, indicating an excellent show and recording; however only two reviews limit confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers describe the sound as "excellent" and note no issues such as muddiness or drop‑outs.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Acoustic first set is called a "real treat," followed by a second set with strong material like “Not Fade Away,” giving the concert an overall epic and satisfying flow.
